Brief introduction

== History ==
A short lasting project started by [[Rotten]] in [[2004]]. Enthusiastic for a few months, the clan later disbanded when [[Flow]] temporarily went inactive, [[Rotten]] joined [[Be Evil]] and soma moved on to play with [[Smack that Ass]].
